text_markup: The Runner uses {card:Hades Shard} to breach Archives during a run on HQ. For 1 of the accesses in that breach, after choosing a candidate, they use {card:Archives Interface} to apply a replacement effect, removing the chosen candidate from the game instead of accessing it. When the run ends, the Runner uses {card:Zahya Sadeghi: Versatile Smuggler} to gain 1[c] for each time they accessed a card during the run. The access that was replaced does not contribute to the number of credits the Runner gains.
